formalResourcePlan.title: 我想领养的动物
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从说一个喜欢的动物，到说出想领养的动物和理由。

formalResourcePlan.entry: 看领养店图片，说“你喜欢什么动物？”

formalResourcePlan.title: 我眼中的大熊猫
formalResourcePlan.goal: 从提出三个关于大熊猫的问题，到用2—3句话介绍自己眼中的大熊猫。

grammar.title: 一会儿……，一会儿……
grammar.titleEn: Coordinate complex sentence 一会儿……，一会儿……
grammar.scene: 同一只动物在短时间内交替做不同动作。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 一会儿 + 动作/状态1，+ 一会儿 + 动作/状态2
grammar.explanation: 表示短时间内发生的不同动作，或者一种对立的情况。

examples.hanzi: 它一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎobiān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēnshang pá.
examples.english: One moment it sleeps by your feet, and the next it climbs on you.

examples.hanzi: 他一会儿进来，一会儿出去，忙得很。

texts.title: 宠物领养店里的决定
texts.setting: 在一家宠物领养店，王一雪和孩子们在看动物。

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 这只小猫你们养了多久了？
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo nǐmen yǎngle duōjiǔ le?
lines.english: How long have you had this kitten?

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.hanzi: 已经一年多了。第一天看见它的时候，它又脏又小。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng yì nián duō le. Dì-yī tiān kànjiàn tā de shíhou, tā yòu zāng yòu xiǎo.
lines.english: It's been more than a year. When we first saw it on day one, it was dirty and small.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 现在它变得又干净又漂亮了。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài tā biànde yòu gānjìng yòu piàoliang le.
lines.english: Now it has become clean and pretty.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.hanzi: 是啊。它还特别可爱，一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Tā hái tèbié kě'ài, yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎobiān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēnshang pá.
lines.english: Yes. It is also very cute; one moment it sleeps by your feet, and the next it climbs on you.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 你们把它照顾得真好。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bǎ tā zhàogù de zhēn hǎo.
lines.english: You took really good care of it.

lines.speaker: 服务员
lines.hanzi: 它就好像我们的孩子，我们照顾它，它也认得我们了。
lines.pinyin: Tā jiù hǎoxiàng wǒmen de háizi, wǒmen zhàogù tā, tā yě rènde wǒmen le.
lines.english: It's just like our child. We care for it, and it recognizes us too.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 妈妈，我们家也养一只小猫吧。
lines.pinyin: Māma, wǒmen jiā yě yǎng yì zhī xiǎo māo ba.
lines.english: Mom, let's keep a kitten at home too.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 咱们没时间照顾，还是别养了，我周末带你们去北京动物园看动物吧。
lines.pinyin: Zánmen méi shíjiān zhàogù, háishì bié yǎng le, wǒ zhōumò dài nǐmen qù Běijīng Dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù ba.
lines.english: We don't have time to look after one, so let's not. I'll take you to the Beijing Zoo this weekend to see animals.

texts.title: 熊猫问题台
texts.setting: 在动物园，王一雪和孩子们边走边聊。
texts.cultureNote: “十万个为什么”源于中国很受欢迎的少儿科普读物《十万个为什么》，常用来说明孩子充满好奇心、问题多。

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 妈妈，大熊猫这个名字很奇怪，它们跟猫有什么关系？
lines.pinyin: Māma, dàxióngmāo zhège míngzi hěn qíguài, tāmen gēn māo yǒu shénme guānxì?
lines.english: Mom, the name "giant panda" (big bear-cat) is very strange. What relation do they have with cats?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 这个问题问得好，它们跟猫没什么关系，其实应该叫大猫熊。
lines.pinyin: Zhège wèntí wèn de hǎo, tāmen gēn māo méi shénme guānxì, qíshí yīnggāi jiào dàmāoxióng.
lines.english: That's a good question. They don't have much to do with cats; actually they should be called "cat-bears."

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 大熊猫为什么只吃竹子不吃肉？
lines.pinyin: Dàxióngmāo wèishénme zhǐ chī zhúzi bù chī ròu?
lines.english: Why do giant pandas only eat bamboo and not meat?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 它们跟人一样，也可以吃肉，但是对肉不感兴趣。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen gēn rén yíyàng, yě kěyǐ chī ròu, dànshì duì ròu bù gǎn xìngqù.
lines.english: Just like humans, they can eat meat, but they are not interested in it.

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 大熊猫为什么是中国的国宝？
lines.pinyin: Dàxióngmāo wèishénme shì Zhōngguó de guóbǎo?
lines.english: Why are giant pandas China's national treasure?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 全世界只有中国有野生大熊猫，中国是大熊猫的家。
lines.pinyin: Quán shìjiè zhǐyǒu Zhōngguó yǒu yěshēng dàxióngmāo, Zhōngguó shì dàxióngmāo de jiā.
lines.english: China is the only place in the whole world with wild giant pandas; China is their home.

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 我听说有的熊猫出国了，他们去哪儿了？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō yǒude xióngmāo chūguó le, tāmen qù nǎr le?
lines.english: I heard that some pandas went abroad. Where did they go?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 关于这个问题，我得慢慢给你讲。
lines.pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng.
lines.english: Regarding this question, I'll have to explain it to you slowly.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 弟弟，你真是“十万个为什么”。
lines.pinyin: Dìdi, nǐ zhēnshì “shíwàn gè wèishénme”.
lines.english: Little brother, you really are "A Hundred Thousand Whys."

texts.title: 熊猫馆观察报告
texts.setting: 在熊猫馆，王一雪和孩子们在看大熊猫。

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 这只大熊猫一会儿爬上去，一会儿跳下来，可爱极了！
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhī dàxióngmāo yíhuìr pá shàngqu, yíhuìr tiào xiàlai, kě'ài jí le!
lines.english: This panda climbs up one second and jumps down the next; it's so cute!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 它好像还没吃饱，站起来张着嘴找吃的呢。
lines.pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng hái méi chībǎo, zhàn qǐlai zhāngzhe zuǐ zhǎo chī de ne.
lines.english: It seems like it hasn't had enough to eat yet; it's standing up with its mouth open looking for food.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 它身边那只熊猫半天没动，是不是在睡觉呢？
lines.pinyin: Tā shēnbiān nà zhī xióngmāo bàntiān méi dòng, shì bu shì zài shuìjiào ne?
lines.english: The panda next to it hasn't moved for quite a while; is it sleeping?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我看不见它的脸，可能是吧。一般来说，熊猫每天要睡很多次觉。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn bu jiàn tā de liǎn, kěnéng shì ba. Yìbānláishuō, xióngmāo měitiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào.
lines.english: I can't see its face, but probably. Generally speaking, pandas sleep many times a day.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 对，除了睡觉以外，很多时间都在吃东西。
lines.pinyin: Duì, chúle shuìjiào yǐwài, hěn duō shíjiān dōu zài chī dōngxi.
lines.english: Right, besides sleeping, they spend a lot of time eating.

lines.speaker: 刘小明
lines.hanzi: 大熊猫的生活真舒服啊！
lines.pinyin: Dàxióngmāo de shēnghuó zhēn shūfu a!
lines.english: A giant panda's life is really comfortable!

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.hanzi: 妈妈，您帮我和这两只大熊猫照一张照片吧。
lines.pinyin: Māma, nín bāng wǒ hé zhè liǎng zhī dàxióngmāo zhào yì zhāng zhàopiàn ba.
lines.english: Mom, please take a photo of me with these two pandas.

texts.title: 北京动物园参观日记
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪在写日记。
texts.author: 王一雪

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 今天我带小雪和小明去动物园玩了。北京动物园是中国很有名的动物园，里面有非常多的动物，当然，大人和孩子最喜爱的还是大熊猫。每天有很多游客去熊猫馆，他们带着相机去给可爱的大熊猫拍照。动物园早上七点半开门，晚上七点关门，冬天比夏天游客少，所以也比平时早关门一个小时。如果第一次来北京旅游，跟家人一起去北京动物园是个不错的选择。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ dài Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng qù dòngwùyuán wán le. Běijīng Dòngwùyuán shì Zhōngguó hěn yǒumíng de dòngwùyuán, lǐmiàn yǒu fēicháng duō de dòngwù, dāngrán, dàrén hé háizi zuì xǐ'ài de háishì dàxióngmāo. Měitiān yǒu hěn duō yóukè qù xióngmāoguǎn, tāmen dàizhe xiàngjī qù gěi kě'ài de dàxióngmāo pāizhào. Dòngwùyuán zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn kāimén, wǎnshang qī diǎn guānmén, dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān yóukè shǎo, suǒyǐ yě bǐ píngshí zǎo guānmén yí gè xiǎoshí. Rúguǒ dì-yī cì lái Běijīng lǚyóu, gēn jiārén yìqǐ qù Běijīng Dòngwùyuán shì gè búcuò de xuǎnzé.
lines.english: Today I took Xiaoxue and Xiaoming to the zoo. Beijing Zoo is a famous zoo in China with many animals, and both adults and children especially love the giant pandas. Many visitors bring cameras to photograph them. The zoo opens at 7:30 a.m. and closes at 7:00 p.m.; in winter there are fewer visitors than in summer and it closes one hour earlier than usual. For a first trip to Beijing, visiting Beijing Zoo with family is a good choice.
